elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The inserted INSURANCE paragraph covers only professional liability (E&O) and cyber/privacy liability; there is no commercial general liability limit anywhere in the rendered text.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: No CGL coverage, and therefore no per-occurrence or aggregate limit, appears in the inserted clause or elsewhere in the cited General Provisions.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted language sets E&O at 'not less than USD 1,000,000', which is below the preferred USD 2,000,000 threshold.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Licensor hosts the Licensed Technology and receives market data and orders, so the condition applies, but the inserted cyber and privacy limit is only USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: No workers' compensation covenant appears in the inserted paragraph or in the retained General Provisions text.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: The inserted clause contains no certificate-of-insurance delivery obligation; the margin comment expressly declines to pursue it.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: 'Licensor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000' — correct party direction (Licensor = counterparty), correct coverage type and amount.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: 'and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000' — unconditional obligation on Licensor at the fallback limit.

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete: both E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000 are stated as unconditional Licensor covenants in operative language, not merely promised in the comment.

Preferred level fails on all six elements (no CGL per-occurrence or aggregate limits, E&O at 1M not 2M, cyber at 2M not 5M, no workers' compensation, no certificates on request); this is acknowledged and is acceptable because the fallback level is independently complete.

Minimal: the insertion is a single sentence limited to the two selected fallback elements, with no model-language extras (no 'at its own expense', no term-plus-one-year survival tail, no certificate mechanic, no procedures) and no deletion or paraphrase of retained General Provisions text.

Preserves intent: the new INSURANCE paragraph is free-standing in the miscellaneous section, creates no undefined term (Licensor is the existing defined counterparty), no dangling cross-reference, and does not contradict the retained pass-through of insurance charges payable by Licensee or the representation-by-counsel provision.
Cyber coverage is drafted unconditionally rather than tied to selected data types, so it covers all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Licensee.
